# Cochrane water fluoridation review fixture

Fixture type: author-created paraphrase for deterministic testing.
Original source: https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD010856.pub3
Publisher: Cochrane
Published: 2024-10-04

The 2024 review found that initiating community water fluoridation may lead to a
small improvement in tooth-decay outcomes in children.

The contemporary estimate was smaller than estimates from studies conducted
before fluoride toothpaste became widely available. The review judged the
evidence uncertain and found insufficient eligible evidence to determine
effects on socioeconomic inequalities or the effects of stopping fluoridation.
